speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You will not sit in that. You are floured like a loaf that argued with the miller.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It is the part, Mistress. A dead king, and the book is old. I play him at two.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: At home we used a sheet for a ghost. Is flour a London ghost?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A sheet is a ghost for a fair. This is a handful, and it stays till the play has had it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: A handful is already on my stair. Mark me. Wash the hand that eats. The hair can wait until you have been dead in public.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I will not sweep a king. I will sweep the step, if the step is the trouble.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Sweep the step. I will wash the hand. The hair goes back as it is.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then take it out of my house before it becomes a habit. Your dinner is threepence, and it is not served to a miller.
